maddeler.e:
أستوحش (form X)
# أَسْتَوْحِشُ (ʔastawḥišu) /ʔas.taw.ħi.ʃu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥaša)
# أَسْتَوْحِشَ (ʔastawḥiša) /ʔas.taw.ħi.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥaša)
# أَسْتَوْحِشْ (ʔastawḥiš) /ʔas.taw.ħiʃ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْحَشَ (istawḥaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
